description: The bar chart illustrates F1 Score performance (in percent) across multiple datasets for MADLLM and three ablated variants. The horizontal axis lists the categorical datasets in left-to-right order as SMD, PSM, SWaT, SMAP, MSL, and WADI, labeled “Dataset,” with no numeric scale. The vertical axis is labeled “F1 Score (%)” and uses a linear scale ranging from 60 to 100, with tick marks at 60, 70, 80, 90, and 100. For each dataset, four adjacent bars are shown: MADLLM (green), MADLLM w/o prompt pool (blue), MADLLM w/o feature embedding (purple), and MADLLM w/o skip embedding (orange). Approximate bar heights are: SMD—green ~93, blue ~92, purple ~91, orange ~92; PSM—green ~97, blue ~77, purple ~96, orange ~95; SWaT—green ~91, blue ~83, purple ~90, orange ~85; SMAP—green ~93, blue ~69, purple ~69, orange ~67; MSL—green ~87, blue ~69, purple ~85, orange ~85; WADI—green ~74, blue ~63, purple ~64, orange ~68. The bars are grouped by dataset (not stacked), with colors explained in the legend below the plot, and there is no indication that categories are sorted by value or that any bars are specially emphasized beyond their color coding.
